title: Early barge-ins 0.5 to 2 s into each agent reply

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi, I have a few questions about changing a booking, and I'm short on time.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Let me walk you through how a change works. First, I look up the booking and read the current details back to you, so we both know what we are changing. Then I check the new day and time against what is free, and if it is available, I move the booking straight away. After that, I read the new details back to you once more, and when you are happy, I save them and send a confirmation by email or text. From then on the change is complete and nothing further is needed from you.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Sorry, I just need to know if I can do it today.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Yes, you can do it today, right now on this call if you like. Just tell me the new day and time you have in mind and I will check whether it is free and move the booking for you straight away.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Okay, and is there a fee?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: There is no fee for moving a booking, as long as it is more than a day before the original slot. Inside that window there can be a small charge, which I would tell you about before doing anything.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Right, that's fine. Next Monday at nine, please.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Next Monday at nine is free, so I have moved you to it, and the confirmation is on its way to your email. Is there anything else I can help with while you are on the line?
